metadata.selection: E_POOL, parseable, R_AB-labelled rows; 25 rows per source stratum (L25/L20/EXC/CTRL), <= 3 rows per sentence, sentences with a frontier-judge row and both labels; seed 0

metadata.orientation: every predict_* score: higher = more likely UNFAITHFUL (ERROR); 'NA' = not scored

consensus_cost.rule: FULL = sentence peer-pool generation spend / candidates per sentence + z3 CPU ($0.05/core-hour); MARGINAL = z3 only
